commands.summary: Static guards enforce 400 kHz identification, CMD9-before-CMD7, BCM2835 RMW/write spacing, RPi3 Arasan pinmux, and timeout-write ordering.
Formatting and whitespace checks passed for the dirty working tree.
RPi3 kernel check passed with pre-existing hal-arm dead-code warnings only.

commands.command: EMBEDDED_OVERRIDE=target/rpi3-embedded cargo build --release -p cellos-kernel --features board-rpi3 --target aarch64-unknown-none-softfloat
commands.summary: RPi3 release kernel built with the board-specific embedded Cellos bundle.
Published uImage SHA256 409CE418C9C2F0E7A005CB5F0BAF0D07D2DE30CF0B56205B08DEAABB2F8B00C5 with payload SHA256 75B09ABF1F9BC976E345468C359B341166C048DF24409121A1C20BC1DA3F6EA6.
The 16 GB SD reported 30318592 sectors; Cellos read MBR partitions P1-P4, mounted FAT16 plus FAT32 /mnt/sd and /bin, and reached Cellos >.

beforeAfter.before: The external SD probe progressed only after pinmux and CMD9 fixes, then the first CMD17 failed with INT_STATUS=0x00108000 (data timeout).
beforeAfter.after: The same board and card complete CMD17-backed MBR/filesystem reads and boot the Cellos user space to its shell.
